title: VimPrescriptive
description: VIM prescriptive layer (VIM 2.1) — what a definition file prescribes: provisions, references to other documents and clauses, and defined terms

provenance.description: Default provenance of all items in the layer

provisions.description: Provisions of the definition file, in reading order

references.description: References to other documents and clauses

terms.description: Terms that provisions use, defined in the definition file or in a referenced document

Definition.description: Identity of the definition file. A reference in another VIM document can match these values

identifier.description: Designation of the file as its publisher writes it

issued.description: ISO 8601 date of issue: a year (2008), a year and month (2008-11), or a full date (2008-11-01). Write only the precision that the file gives

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. cs, en) of the verbatim text in the layer. A statement of the producer can be in another language

Reference.description: A link from the definition file to another document or to another clause of the same file

reference_id.description: Identifier, unique in the layer. Checked by the identifier check of the contract validation, not by this schema

scope.description: external (another document) or internal (another clause of this file)

binding.description: mandatory (needed to apply the file) or informative

target.description: What the reference points to. An external target has an identifier or a title (a title or description only when the file gives no designation), an internal target has a clause

anchors.description: Places where the reference is written

provenance.description: Provenance of this reference; overrides the provenance of the layer

identifier.description: Designation of the target document, as written

edition.description: Edition of the target document. Absent means any edition

title.description: Title of the target document, or its description when the file names it only by a description (e.g. the fire safety drawings of this project)

uri.description: Location of the target document or of its VIM, when known

Term.description: A term that provisions use. The definition file defines it, or it refers to the document that defines it (references)

term_id.description: Identifier, unique in the layer. Checked by the identifier check of the contract validation, not by this schema

definition.description: Text of the definition. May be left out for licence reasons

references.description: reference_id values of the layer that point to the document that defines the term; each value must exist in the layer (identifier check)

anchors.description: Places of the definition in the file

provenance.description: Provenance of this term; overrides the provenance of the layer
